verdict.rationale: AI Gateway exposes an OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions` endpoint and lets you connect via providers' native API formats, so developers can use official provider SDKs (e.g. OpenAI SDK) pointed at the gateway URL, and a patchLog method suggests some Gateway-specific SDK support. However there's no clear evidence of a dedicated, multi-language official Cloudflare AI Gateway SDK beyond this compatibility layer.
